{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS004153","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Direct-match candidates for breast carcinoma are abundant. Within that family, PGS004153 (UKBB-EUR.MultiPRS.CV) has the strongest reported full-model discrimination and variance-explained among its siblings (AUROC 0.6625; R² 0.0764) with strong per-SD effect size (OR 1.826), while avoiding explicit clinical risk-calculator packaging or family-history augmentation.
